messages:
mira-ml: Quick heads-up — onboarding evals for q3b-int4-cand show a reproducible drop on the 'multi-turn synthesis' slice (~5.8 ROUGE-L). Noticed after last night's dedupe sweep.

jonas-curate: Thanks for flagging. Which promptset and dedupe pipeline did we run? could be we stripped paraphrase anchors used as golden exemplars.

mira-ml: Using promptset synth_multiturn_v1 (~16k examples). Dedupe was a MinHash pass at 0.78 + exact fuzzy 0.92 to squash near-duplicates. Dedup log attached to RDW-94567.

lee-labelops: If anchor variants were removed that preserve coherence across turns, we've seen similar brittleness. I can prep a microgolden batch if we need it.

anya-eng: Before relabeling, let's confirm quant vs data issue. I'll spin up an A/B constrained to that slice with identical decoding seeds and pinned kernels.

mira-ml: Eval command used: 
```bash
python eval/run_eval.py --model q3b-int4-cand --dataset datasets/synth_multiturn_v1.jsonl \
  --slice multi_turn_synthesis --metric rougeL --seed 7 --batch 8 --decoding beam=4
```

probe-bot: Deploy note: q3b-int4-cand staged 2024-07-10T02:11:05Z. Perf 470 tok/s, KV 0.82GB/slot.

jonas-curate: Proposal: sample a 500-example microgolden (250 golden anchors + 250 review) stratified by #turns and entity-density. Also produce a "restore list" of near-dupes removed by MinHash for direct comparison.

lee-labelops: I can queue that. Requesting +520 label units for 48h to avoid backlog. Will include checklist: CONSIST (cross-turn consistency), HALL (hallucination), ORDER (turn ordering), OMIT (missing step).

anya-eng: I'll run the A/B (baseline q3b-fp16 vs int4 candidate) on the microgolden and add token-alignment traces (top-3 beams) to the harness. Pinning kernel flags and turning off autotune to remove variability.

mira-ml: For traceability I'll add a tiny eval diff that computes per-token KL to baseline and logs top-5 decoding divergence. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/501

probe-bot: AB job queued: job_id=ab-synth-1768212345, shards=6. Expect ~90m. :hourglass:

jonas-curate: I'll open RDW-94567 and attach sampling seeds, dedupe-restore whitelist, and a short label rubric for reviewers.

lee-labelops: Holding label start until AB finishes. Also will add burnout guard and a 10% QA spotcheck.

probe-bot: AB results posted: q3b-fp16 baseline > q3b-int4-cand on multi_turn_synthesis by 5.6 ROUGE-L (p=0.002). Token-diff archives: /evals/ab-synth-1768212345/logs.tar.gz

anya-eng: Stats look significant. I'll kick off a kernel bisect focusing on int4 attention accumulation and also run a forced-fp16 math path for direct numeric comparison.

mira-ml: Given the AB, recommend running the microgolden relabel + a compact quant calibration sweep in parallel. Calibration plan: perplexity-weighted calibration with longer-turn examples upweighted.

jonas-curate: Agreed. I'll expand the golden set by +200 anchors targeting multi-turn coherence edgecases and update RDW-94567.

lee-labelops: Label batch queued now (500 examples). ETA artifacts ~36-44h. Posting interim QA snippets to RDW-94567. :white_check_mark:

anya-eng: Bisect update: isolated divergence to int4 accumulate op in cross-attn path on sequences > 1024 tokens. Repro on forced-run. Logs: /infra/bisect/1768212345/report.txt

mira-ml: Thanks. If kernel op is the root cause, short-term mitigation = hold rollout + patch kernel; medium-term = golden expansion + calibration to make model robust. We'll compare post-relabel + calibration results before deciding.

jonas-curate: Action items recap: (1) lee post label artifacts + QC to RDW-94567, (2) anya publish bisect findings and patch plan, (3) mira run post-relabel regression harness and report, (4) ops keep AB logs linked.

lee-labelops: Labels in progress; first QC batch looks consistent so far. Will share spotcheck samples.

probe-bot: AB thread closed; reopen when relabel artifacts or kernel patch posted.
